definitions.gloss: great panic; frantic haste; being flustered
definitions.explanation: A state of extreme hurry, panic, or confusion, typically in response to an unexpected situation.

examples.english: I left the house in a great hurry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寝坊|ねぼう}して→寝坊する：16731_nebousuru⟧{大慌|おおあわ}て⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{支度|したく}→支度：02083_shitaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I overslept and got ready in a frantic rush.

examples.japanese: ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}り{出|だ}して→降り出す：03004_furidasu⟧、⟦{洗濯物|せんたくもの}→洗濯物：09533_sentakumono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{込|こ}む→取り込む：05871_torikomu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{大慌|おおあわ}てだった。
examples.english: It suddenly started raining, and I was in a complete panic bringing in the laundry.

notes:
Composed of {大|おお} (great, big) + ⟦{慌|あわ}て→慌てる：01874_awateru⟧ (haste, fluster). The prefix {大|おお} intensifies the base word ⟦{慌|あわ}て→慌てる：01874_awateru⟧. Used to describe comical or relatable situations of panic.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大慌|おおあわ}て⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (in a great hurry, frantically)
- {大慌|おおあわ}て⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become flustered/panicked)
- {大慌|おおあわ}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧ (a flustered appearance)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{慌|あわ}てる→慌てる：01874_awateru⟧ — to panic, to be flustered (verb form, less intense)
- ⟦あたふた→あたふた：20601_atafuta⟧ — in a fluster, hurriedly (onomatopoeia describing the frantic manner)
- ⟦{焦|あせ}る→焦る：04619_aseru⟧ — to feel anxious, to rush (more about internal anxiety than outward chaos)
- てんやわんや — commotion, chaos (describes a chaotic scene, often involving multiple people)
